create_Timer: create a Timer instance that starts tracking elapsed time in milliseconds from initialization
reset_Timer: reset the Timer start time to the current moment to restart elapsed time tracking
get_time_since_start_Timer: get the elapsed time since the Timer started formatted as a human-readable string
unix_time_since_start_Timer: get the elapsed time since the Timer started as a raw number in seconds or milliseconds
get_time_hhmmss_Timer: calculate and format a time gap between two timestamps as a human-readable hh:mm:ss string
